The Standing

A single number that answers, and a request that is simply handled — quietly, completely, and without the word no.

The Service

What we arrange

01

Travel & Flight

Private and commercial itineraries, last-minute seats, upgrades, jets and charters — booked, changed, and watched end to end.

02

Stays & Residences

Suites held after sell-out, villas, members' houses and the room that isn't listed — with your preferences already in place on arrival.

03

Access & Reservations

The table tonight, the box for the final, the opening, the archive appointment — where a name alone does not open the door.

04

Personal Requests

Gifting, sourcing, celebrations, the errand three time zones away. If it can be done, we find who does it and see it done.

05

Yachts & Charters

Crewed yachts, sailing weeks and day charters across the Mediterranean and both American coasts — provisioned to your table before you step aboard.

06

The Impossible

The requests that begin with "I don't suppose…". Bring us the ones everyone else has declined.

Where will you go

A world, on standing

The Privileges of Standing

What membership grants you

Reach

The Standing Line

One number, one person who knows you — answered in ninety seconds, at three in the morning, in any time zone. Never a queue, never a menu.

Recognition

Status, Conferred

Top-tier airline and hotel standing from day one — suites, upgrades and late checkout as a matter of course, without the nights or the miles.

Air

Worldwide Private Aviation

Private jets and helicopters, empty-leg fares and the last seat on a sold-out flight — anywhere on earth, at member rates and watched from gate to gate.

Protection

A Guardian Abroad

Round-the-clock medical, security and evacuation cover — and a human who steps in and makes it right when a trip goes wrong, wherever you are.

Memory

The Travelling Profile

The pillow, the allergy, the car, the wine, the seat — held on file and in place at every door, so you are never asked to explain yourself twice.

First Word

Before the Public

New openings, released allocations and the reservation window before it is a window — you hear of it first, and your name is already down.

Membership

Joined by referral

Meridian is not open to application. Members are introduced by members, and the circle is kept deliberately small.

I

Introduced

An existing member puts your name forward. We hold a short, private conversation to understand how you live and travel.

II

Appointed

You are paired with a dedicated concierge who keeps your preferences, people and standing accounts on hand.

III

On Call

One number, answered at any hour. You ask; the rest is ours. Membership is annual and by invitation only.
